entry.title: New: Bill 107 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, DEPARTMENT OF FIRE AND PUBLIC SAFETY, ADMINISTRATION PROGRAM AND TRAINING PROGRAM" The purpose of this bill is to amend the Fiscal Year 2024 Budget, Department of Fire and Public Safety, Administration Program by decreasing the equivalent personnel by 2.0 and the appropriation under Category A by $82,884 and increasing the equivalent personnel and the appropriation under Category A for the Training Program in the same amount.
